hiring.zeroPolicy: Keep zero-opening cohorts in audit and calendar support; they contribute zero binomial likelihood. Fit existing fixed-penalty model to positive-exposure cohorts only.

satisfaction.targetIdentity: Predict continuation of latest observed instrument, item set, scoring and eligibility versions; score only matching future waves. An unseen instrument break cannot be known at forecast time.

protocol.selection: No winner selection, parameter search or promotion. All fixed candidates and abstentions reported. Training seeds and origins provide development comparisons; test seeds are never fitted jointly or used to change methods.
protocol.controls: Stationary case is the no-trend-signal control. Reversal changes outcomes after the test origin without supplying its family or change date to models. Reporting stress and instrument break test release and comparability guards. These controls are simplified simulations, not validated real-world shift frequencies.
protocol.reserve: October–December outcomes are not scored or read by this evaluator. Demo projection uses September as-of releases only and one prespecified stationary case.
protocol.uncertainty: All intervals null: no calibrated cross-scenario uncertainty is established.

protocolClarifications: The frozen reserve wording refers to target periods/cohorts: no October–December turnover counts, opening cohorts or survey waves are scored. July–September hiring cohorts require 90-day follow-up that overlaps October–December calendar dates. Reserve calendar events are therefore not wholly untouched.

Stationary denotes a stable generating mechanism, not stationary turnover counts: changing stock and seasonality create count signal. Stationary hiring fractions and survey scores have no expected trend. Earlier paired-prefix turnover controls separately test a shock with no pre-origin signal.

An existing hiring optimizer failed during training before test evaluation. Commit 279c9e4d4125550bc6656336cea269dde76037f9 converts only its known numerical failures to case abstention; optimizer settings and candidates were not changed.
custody: Protocol committed before generation; no independent blinding. Fixed methods are fitted only to each origin history; no fitting or method selection across assessment outcomes.
